free_tier.stated: A published technical account states that the 'K-Cloud Project (MSIT · NIPA, 3 years from 2023)' builds a domestic-NPU cloud through a consortium of three CSPs and three chip makers, and that the 'High-Performance Computing Support Program (MSIT · NIPA, ~16.7B KRW in 2026): provides domestic NPU servers free of charge to selected demand companies'. 'Gabia, for instance, provides Rebellions ATOM-Max at no cost.' 'We too obtained 4× ATOM+ cards through one of these paths, in the form of KT Cloud’s AI Nexus (Backend.AI-based under the hood).'
